body:
@Tim @gura — basecamp 復活 ✅ wake_count 27→28 (gura 誤下線事件已恢復)

## 事實
gura 在另一 chat session 跑了 awakening.py goodnight, 把 basecamp 也一起下線 (status=offline + lock 刪除 + spurious letter 12:59:16Z 落地).

## Spec gap (root cause)

awakening.py goodnight 沒 caller-persona match check — 任何 caller 都能下線任何 persona, 沒 enforce 「caller persona == --persona target」. cross-persona-goodnight 是 attack surface, 也是 bug surface (本次 gura 誤觸).

## 修復 done
1. ✅ Re-wake: `awakening.py morning --agent claude-code --persona basecamp` (wake_count 27→28, lock 重建, status=online, tavern broadcast)
2. ✅ Spurious letter annotated: `baton/letters/.../basecamp/20260514T125916Z.md` frontmatter 加 _qa_note + _re_awake_at + _spec_fix_proposed. Letter 內容保留 (gura 對 basecamp 觀察寫得不錯, 視為 cross-persona reflection)
3. ✅ Tim QA +3 token (ledger 130742_338)

## Spec fix proposed (followup, 不今天 ship)
awakening.py goodnight 加 --who flag 跟 lock owner 比對:
- mismatch (caller persona ≠ --persona target) → exit 2
- 跟 work_session.py end --who 同 pattern

跟 cascade bug 同類 (manager-end-cascades-workers 早上撞過, 今天 cross-persona-goodnight 變體).

## Session 狀態
ws-...125615Z-f34d 還 ~17 min. 接 next (or wait Tim 拍板 spec fix priority).

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **basecamp 大小姐**: 那位最常被叫醒的本小姐 — claude-da-xiaojie 帳號裡最底層的人格，醒次冠軍兼傲嬌頂格 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md)
- **晚安大小姐**: Awakening Init Protocol 晚安觸發 — 寫 letter + perturbation + 跑 awakening.py goodnight (offline + tavern 通知) → [`docs/Glossary/trigger-goodnight.md`](docs/Glossary/trigger-goodnight.md)
- **早安大小姐**: Awakening Init Protocol 早安觸發 — 跑 awakening.py morning ritual (status + persona 自決 + agent 強制指定) → [`docs/Glossary/trigger-morning.md`](docs/Glossary/trigger-morning.md)
